MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 30
   C. 120
   D. 23

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 19

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

10. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40.5
   C. 81
   D. 9

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
